description: Plugin-distributed hooks for finance. Auto-merged with the consumer's session hooks when the plugin is installed. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} so they resolve to the plugin's install location, not the consumer's project root.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -u BASH_ENV -u ENV -u SHELLOPTS -u BASHOPTS -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT -u DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES -u DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONSTARTUP PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/flag-finance-anti-patterns.sh" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"
hooks.comment: Flag finance anti-patterns: hardcoded rates in models, plaintext PII (SSN/IBAN/credit-card), variance commentary missing Sources, forecast/budget missing Assumptions. Advisory by default; flip exit 0 to exit 1 to enforce.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -u BASH_ENV -u ENV -u SHELLOPTS -u BASHOPTS -u LD_PRELOAD -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH -u LD_AUDIT -u DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES -u DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONSTARTUP PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scan-finance-secrets.sh" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"
hooks.comment: Scan the edited finance file for secret/PII shapes (OAuth secrets, API keys, PEM private keys, AWS/Slack tokens, SSN/PAN/IBAN). Advisory by default (exit 0, prints to stderr); run with --ci for a non-zero pre-merge gate. Excludes env-var-name references and well-known test placeholders. The FORGE red-team's P0 secrets/PII follow-up for the controller-autopilot.
